meta.name: Bigg Boss
meta.description: Many contestants live in a purpose-built house and are isolated from the rest of the world. Every week, housemates nominate two of their fellow housemates for eviction.

videos.title: The Boss Is Here
videos.overview: Ulaganayagan Kamal Haasan takes us on a tour of the well-equipped Bigg Boss House. Get set to be amazed as he introduces the contestants!

videos.title: Day 1: Who's The House Leader
videos.overview: The contestants choose their leader on their first day in the Bigg Boss House. Who is it?

videos.title: Day 2: Snehan Takes The Lead
videos.overview: Things have begun to heat up as the contestants need to nominate 2 vote-outs. Nominating Snehan to lead everybody, Bigg Boss has an exceptional task on hand. What is it?

videos.title: Day 3: The Magic Of First Love
videos.overview: Bigg Boss instructs the contestants to talk about their first love. Vaiyapuri and Namitha feel homesick, while Juliana suspects a cold war rising against her.

videos.title: Day 4: The Drama Heats Up
videos.overview: The episode opens with another cat fight and Juliana's birthday celebration. The contestants have to tag their soulmates in the primary task of the day.

videos.title: Day 5: First Bigg Boss Tamil Awards
videos.overview: The contestants are told to get ready for their first Bigg Boss Tamil Awards, based on their performances in the past few days. Will this create unrest?

videos.title: Day 6: Week One Review With Bigg Boss
videos.overview: Bigg Boss reviews the first week with the contestants and mentions of an elimination which is due next week.

videos.title: Day 7: First Elimination
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan tells Anuya and Juliana which contestants voted against them and announces the name of the eliminated contestant. Also, watch the contestants enact songs from Kamal Haasan's movies!

videos.title: Day 8: A New Leader Is Chosen
videos.overview: The contestants choose their new leader and give their elimination nominations for the week. Who is the leader now?

videos.title: Day 9: Bigg Boss Says Recite Tamil Anthem
videos.overview: The contestants are told to recite the Tamizh Thaai Vaazhthu, which ends in a dispute between Gayathri and Juliana!

videos.title: Day 10: New Set Of Challenges
videos.overview: The contestants get an interesting task of dedicating proverbs to each other. Who will impress Bigg Boss?

videos.title: Day 11: Twists And Turns In The House
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns Snehan to give tongue-twisters to each contestant but the real twist comes when Juliana makes a decision!

videos.title: Day 12: Big Boss Annual School Festival
videos.overview: Will Gayathri’s request to Bigg Boss for chocolate powder be accepted? Meanwhile, Bigg Boss asks Snehan to organise an annual school function with a skit and a singing and dance performance. Who will shine?

videos.title: Day 13: Who Is Next
videos.overview: Adding to the drama, Kamal Haasan surprises everyone with a no elimination episode. He questions the contestants about the Bigg Boss school and Juliana's fight. The housemates are given a task to shop food items. Who will leave the house this week?

videos.title: Day 14: Unexpected Turn Of Events
videos.overview: The Bigg Boss contestants are stunned when Kamal Haasan announces the name of the eliminated contestant.

videos.title: Day 15: Bharani's Dramatic Escape Attempt
videos.overview: A frustrated Bharani tries to escape from the house by jumping over the wall. Will the Bigg Boss evict him?

videos.title: Day 16: Virumaandis In The House
videos.overview: The contestants dress up as Kamal Haasan's movie character, Virumaandi and dance whenever the songs assigned to them are played. Later, Bigg Boss punishes Aarav and Raisa. Why?

videos.title: Day 17: Contestants Become 'Superstars'
videos.overview: The contestants become Superstar Rajinikanth's movie character Padaiyappa and rock the house. Bigg Boss asks Ganesh to predict the order in which his fellow contestants are going to get evicted!

videos.title: Day 18: Thala - Thalapathy Fever
videos.overview: As part of today's task, the contestants dress up like superstars Ajith and Vijay and perform a dance marathon!

videos.title: Day 19: Juliana Is The Hot Topic
videos.overview: The drama quotient increases exponentially as Juliana becomes the topic of discussion among the housemates. Namita has two days to learn Tamil, while Razia and Snehan quarrel over the food.

videos.title: Day 20: Raiza Bears The Brunt
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes Raiza for her frequently speaking in English. Kamal Haasan asks some challenging questions to the contestants. Will it create unrest in the house?

videos.title: Day 21: A Dramatic Eviction
videos.overview: Amidst tension, Kamal Haasan announces the name of the evicted contestant. What does Bharani say about his escape attempt?

videos.title: Day 22: Who Will Rule The House?
videos.overview: Shakthi, Oviya and Namitha compete in an endurance challenge to be the new leader. Who will get to rule the house?

videos.title: Day 23: A Thief In The House?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a character to each contestant and asks them to protect a diamond from being stolen. But, who is the thief?

videos.title: Day 24: The Hunt Begins!
videos.overview: The contestants learn that the diamond has been stolen and try to find the thief. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Day 25: Tamil Thalaivas In The House
videos.overview: Tamil Thalaivas, Tamil Nadu's Pro Kabaddi League team visit and play a Kabaddi match with the Bigg Boss housemates. Later, the joy in the house disappears when Juliana falls ill!

videos.title: Day 26: Nine Against One?
videos.overview: Namita and Gayathri ask the other contestants to stand with them against Oviya. The contestants compete in a fast food challenge.

videos.title: Day 27: Kamal Reveals Oviya's Truth
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan makes each contestant understand the issue involving Oviya.

videos.title: Day 28: Eviction Creates Confusion
videos.overview: As Kamal Haasan prepares to announce the name of the evicted contestant, Gayathri and Juliana rejoice assuming that there is no eviction this week. But is it true?

videos.title: Day 29: Who Will Win?
videos.overview: Juliana tries convincing Aarav that Oviya is lying. Later, Aarav and Snehan compete in an interesting game to become this week's leader.

videos.title: Day 30: Cycling Task Irks Vaiyapuri
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks assigns a cycling task to the contestants but Vaiyapuri isn't happy about it. Why?

videos.title: Day 31: Oviya, Gayathri Become Reporters
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks Oviya and Gayathri to become news reporters and interview all the housemates. How will this change things in the house?

videos.title: Day 32: Who Is The Jr Bigg Boss?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes the contestants by reducing their luxury budget points and assigns a task to select the Junior Bigg Boss of the house. Who will it be?

videos.title: Day 33: Oviya, Juliana Clash
videos.overview: As part of a task, Juliana assigns Oviya to put out a red carpet for her. But, it ends in a fight. How?

videos.title: Day 34: Kamal Sets Things Right
videos.overview: The contestants enact a scene from the movie "Avvai Shanmugi" with a motive. Kamal Hassan sets things right between the contestants.

videos.title: Day 35: Welcome The New Contestant
videos.overview: Secrets are revealed as everyone gets a chance to talk for each other and answer Kamal Hassan's questions. A new contestant enters the house.

videos.title: Day 36: Shock Treatment!
videos.overview: Bindu Madhavi has a task for everyone that makes them run. Bigg Boss gives everybody a task of giving someone a shock treatment. Who is the bait?

videos.title: Day 39: Oviya Isolates Herself
videos.overview: Oviya sleeps outside the living area, doesn't participate in the tasks, and snubs other contestants. Meanwhile, Aarav continues to avoid her. Will someone solve her problems?

videos.title: Day 40: Oviya Wants To Leave
videos.overview: Bigg Boss organises a tug of war in the house. An unstable Oviya says that she wants to leave the house. Will she?

videos.title: Day 41: Oviya Exits!
videos.overview: The crowd gives a massive reception to their favourite as Oviya leaves the Bigg Boss house.

videos.title: Day 42: Another Departure!
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan speaks personally to each contestant about the incidents that led to Oviya's exit and announces the name of the evicted contestant.

videos.title: Day 43: A Surprising Decision!
videos.overview: After asking the contestants to give their eviction nominations for the week, Bigg Boss stuns everyone with an announcement. What is it?

videos.title: Day 44: A Battle On The Cards
videos.overview: Bigg Boss divides the contestants into two teams with separate luxury budget points, based on their performance. Will it create a conflict?

videos.title: Day 45: Unrest In The House
videos.overview: Bigg Boss assigns some contestants with an alternative task as they are unhappy with the laundry task. Someone gets scared after the task is performed. What happened?

videos.title: Day 46: Who Is The Lucky One?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss announces that one of the contestants can be saved from eviction and asks them to cast their votes. Later, there's a rift between Gayathri and Raiza.

videos.title: Day 47: Elimination Advantage Challenge
videos.overview: A thief and clown gain entry into the house and do their best to disturb everyone. Each contestant has to answer 5 questions to gain advantage in this week's elimination. Who will win this task?

videos.title: Day 48: Sathish And Sripriya Visit
videos.overview: Actors Sathish Krishnan and Sripriya visit the show with questions for Bigg Boss on his elimination strategy and situation handling with contestants and more.

videos.title: Day 49: Whose Turn Is it?
videos.overview: The contestants aren't in a mood to celebrate the 50th day in the house as Kamal Haasan announces the name of the eliminated contestant!

videos.title: Day 50: Open Nominations
videos.overview: The contestants compete in a game to become the leader for the week. Bigg Boss asks each contestant to give their eviction nominations in the presence of others!

videos.title: Day 51: Ghost In The House?
videos.overview: The contestants give a short speech about India, on the occasion of Independence day. Later, Snehan and Aarav try to scare Bindu. What's their plan?

videos.title: Day 52: Another Wild Card Entry
videos.overview: Raiza is annoyed with Vaiyapuri's behaviour. Later, a new contestant enters the house as a wild card entry. Who is it?

videos.title: Day 53: A Surprising Entry!
videos.overview: Snehan and Bindu play a prank on Suja. Gayatri and Aarav are mad at Snehan. Later, the contestants are in for a surprise as a new member joins them.

videos.title: Day 54: VJ Kajal In The House
videos.overview: Vaiyapuri, Aarav and Snehan are unhappy after the rice packing challenge. Later, VJ Kajal makes a dramatic entry. Is she in the house to stay?

videos.title: Day 55: Kamal Loses His Cool
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan lashes out at the contestants for disrespecting Bigg Boss and decides to speak only to the newcomers. Later, the contestants answer some controversial questions from the viewers.

videos.title: Day 56: Who Leaves This Week?
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan questions the housemates regarding the nominated contestants Raiza and Gayathri and announces the name of the evicted contestant. Later, there are some controversial questions aimed at the evicted one.

videos.title: Day 57: Who Is The New Leader?
videos.overview: The newcomers compete in an exciting game to become the leader for the week. Later, the contestants give their eviction nominations!

videos.title: Day 58: A Nomination Chain!
videos.overview: Aarav gets nominated for next week's eviction after pressing a buzzer but has a chance to transfer his nomination. How?

videos.title: Day 59: Raiza In Trouble Again!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss punishes the contestants for sleeping during the day and seeks an explanation from Raiza for the same. Meanwhile, Bindu has a tough task ahead.

videos.title: Day 60: Killers In The House
videos.overview: Bigg Boss tells the contestants that there are two killers in the house and assigns Vaiyapuri and Kajal the task to catch them. Who are the killers and what's their modus operandi?

videos.title: Day 61: Double Murder Mystery
videos.overview: Bigg Boss welcomes the housemates to the Bigg Boss Wrestling Federation. Ganesh and Raiza are killed by the mysterious killers. Are the others safe?

videos.title: Day 62: The People's Court
videos.overview: The killers reveal themselves after two more murders. Some housemates get a chance to confront others, the legal way.

videos.title: Day 63: Surprise Or Shock?
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan stuns everyone by introducing a new pattern for conducting the eviction. Does he have more surprises up his sleeve?

videos.title: Day 64: Unexpected Visitors!
videos.overview: The contestants give their eviction nominations for the week. Later, they are astonished when two guests arrive at the house!

videos.title: Day 65: Madurai Team Vs NRI Team
videos.overview: Bigg Boss divides the housemates into 2 teams and asks them to compete against each other. But, the first task itself creates some problems!

videos.title: Day 66: Shift Of Power!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss announces that the Madurai team will gain control of the house and NRI team members should serve them. Later, Julie gets grilled about her equation with Oviya and Aarav.

videos.title: Day 67: Wedding Bells in The House
videos.overview: Harish and Bindu get married but have to compete with Aarav and Suja to succeed in their marriage. Aarav gets hurt during the task. Will Harish win?

videos.title: Day 68: Bindu is Punished!
videos.overview: Bindu is punished for delaying in doing a task Bigg Boss assigned to her. Aarthi and Juli argue when Bigg Boss asks them to decide the winning team.

videos.title: Day 69: An Attempt to Prank Kamal
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks the contestants to enact some scenes that happened in the house and also asks them to play a prank on Kamal Haasan. Will the housemates succeed?

videos.title: Day 70: It's Eviction Time!
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan announces the name of the evicted contestant. Aarav is arrested and taken out by masked men in black, but one masked man stays in the house.

videos.title: Day 71: Leader Election
videos.overview: Bigg Boss introduces a new method to choose the leader for the week. Later, the housemates submit their eviction nominations. Who will get maximum votes?

videos.title: Day 72: The Boss Says 'Stop'
videos.overview: Bigg Boss introduces an interesting task called 'Freeze and Release'. Later, Juliana gets annoyed by something that Aarthi does.

videos.title: Day 73: Bigg Boss' Surprise!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss continues the 'Freeze and Release' task and gives heartwarming surprises to Vaiyapuri, Bindu and Harish. Later, an endurance task creates tension in the house!

videos.title: Day 74: Loved Ones Visit!
videos.overview: Snehan finds it difficult to control his tears when his father comes all the way from his village to see him. Ganesh also receives a delightful surprise!

videos.title: Day 75: Sweet Surprise for Aarav and Suja
videos.overview: Aarav and Suja are happy when some visitors take them by surprise. Bindu loses a bag of chocolates. Did someone steal it?

videos.title: Day 76: Vishnu, Catherine in the House
videos.overview: Actors Vishnu Vishal and Catherine Tresa stun everyone with their surprise entry and claim to be the new wild card entries. Are they?

videos.title: Day 77: A Surprise for Suja
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan announces that Harish and Bindu are safe. Later, he asks Suja to come out of the house. What's in store for her?

videos.title: Day 78: Aarav Leads The Way
videos.overview: Bigg Boss chooses Aarav as this week's leader. The housemates are surprised to see Suja back in the house. Later, they give their eviction nominations for the week.

videos.title: Day 79: Ticket to The Finale!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives the housemates an endurance task to win points and secure the ticket to the finale. Looks like the real fight has just begun!

videos.title: Day 80: Snehan, Suja Won't Give Up
videos.overview: As Snehan and Suja refuse to end the task, Bigg Boss toughens up the rules. After hours of endurance, will the two finally give in to Bigg Boss?

videos.title: Day 81: Housemates In Knots
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to form pairs, tie each other and free themselves from a complicated knot, as part of the ticket to finale task. Later, they show their artistic talents!

videos.title: Day 82: All for a Ticket to the Finale
videos.overview: The men wear Bindu's dress, do a ramp walk and dance around the house. The housemates express themselves to win points and the ticket to the finale.

videos.title: Day 83: Steal and Win Points
videos.overview: Bigg Boss tells the housemates to steal things from other housemates and drop it in a basket for points. Harish, Vaiyapuri, Aarav and Snehan are nominated for eviction.

videos.title: Day 84: Kamal In the House
videos.overview: Kamal goes inside the house to hand over the Golden Ticket to a surprise winner. Later, he announces the name of the evicted contestant. Who is it?

videos.title: Day 85: Fight to Escape Eviction
videos.overview: Bigg Boss says that everyone, except Snehan is nominated for this week's eviction and gives them a way to escape. Later, a task turns a tad bit violent.

videos.title: Day 86: The Egg Challenge
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives each contestant an egg and asks them to protect it at all times. Who will win the next Ticket to the Finale?

videos.title: Day 87: Angels Vs Demons
videos.overview: The contestants divide themselves into teams of angels and demons for the second part of the Ticket To Finale tasks. What are they supposed to do?

videos.title: Day 88: Role Reversal
videos.overview: As Aarav, Harish and Bindu fail to open the locker, Bigg Boss asks the demons to become angels and vice versa. Will the new demons win?

videos.title: Day 89: The Egg Challenge
videos.overview: Bigg Boss gives each contestant an egg and asks them to protect it at all times. Who will win the next ticket to the finale?

videos.title: Day 90: Kamal's Important Announcement
videos.overview: The contestants are assigned various tasks with eggs hanging from their necks! Kamal Haasan makes an important announcement regarding the Finale points. What is it?

videos.title: Day 91: Who Will Snehan Save?
videos.overview: Snehan can save Ganesh or Suja from eviction by giving his points to them. Who will be the lucky one?

videos.title: Day 92: Actress Anjali Visits
videos.overview: The housemates give a grand welcome to the gorgeous actress Anjali, from the upcoming movie Balloon. What exciting tasks will she come up with?

videos.title: Day 93: Dance Marathon is Back!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to dress up like movie characters and dance whenever the song assigned to them is played. Later, Snehan gets emotional thinking about leaving the house.

videos.title: Day 94: Bigg Boss Makes a Tempting Offer
videos.overview: Bigg Boss offers a huge amount of money to the housemates to leave the house immediately. Will anyone take the bait?

videos.title: Day 95: The Last Eviction!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss arranges an award function for the housemates. Find out who among the last 5 contestants get evicted.

videos.title: Day 96: Freeze to Get Surprises!
videos.overview: Bigg Boss brings back the Freeze And Release task to give the housemates some delightful surprises. Snehan writes a brilliant song about their stay in the house!

videos.title: Day 97: Aarav or Snehan?
videos.overview: After the finalists celebrate with evicted participants, Ganesh Venkatraman and Harish find themselves out of the house. The contest is then between Aarav and Snehan. Who will be the winner of Season 1 of Bigg Boss?

videos.title: Kamal Haasan Kickstarts Season 2
videos.overview: Superstar, Kamal Haasan kickstarts the show with sixteen interesting housemates eager to begin their journey in the Bigg Boss house. Watch 'The Legend' get the ball rolling, however, with a twist in the tale.

videos.title: Day 1 in the House
videos.overview: Three candidates, one captain. Who among Janani, Mumtaj and Mahath will take charge as the first captain of Bigg Boss Season 2?

videos.title: Day 2 in the House
videos.overview: Problems are many and Janani desperately needs to prove her mettle as a captain. Will she succeed amidst all the luxury budget ruckus?

videos.title: Day 3 in the House
videos.overview: The shackles have come off and the first ever argument breaks out among the contestants. Watch Nithya's adamant demeanor turn her into the villain of the house.

videos.title: Day 4 in the House
videos.overview: A major rule violation has led to the contestants losing a significant part of their budget. What did they do?

videos.title: Day 5 in the House
videos.overview: Aishwarya and Janani kiss while Mumtaz and Bhalaji wear diapers and act like kids. All is not well between Mumtaz and Nithya. Janani is asked to name the underperfomers after three housemates are applauded for their efforts.

videos.title: Day 6 in the House
videos.overview: From the contestants' first-week experiences to Nithya and Mumtaz's onion fiasco, Kamal Haasan is here to peel it all out, layer by layer. Watch the drama unfold.

videos.title: Day 7 in the House
videos.overview: A happy ride takes a dramatic turn when Kamal Haasan brings the eviction back into focus. Who will pack their bags?

videos.title: Day 8 in the House
videos.overview: From being dominating personalities to their inability to handle a joke, the seniors are facing backlash, every step of the way. Are they being targeted for elimination?

videos.title: Day 9 in the House
videos.overview: Mumtaz and Mamathi turning rebellious has created an unrest during the master-servant task. Witness the ruckus in its purest form where solution is just a far fetched idea.

videos.title: Day 10 in the House
videos.overview: Mumtaz disobeys Bigg Boss's order to wear her mic. Aishwarya and Yashika's raunchy dance has the men at the edge of their seats.

videos.title: Day 11 in the House
videos.overview: The tides have turned as the roles in the master-servant task have been reversed. From the husband-wife rivalry to Daniel's arrogance, witness the struggle as the house becomes an arena of total chaos.

videos.title: Day 12: It's Men Vs Women!
videos.overview: A task has the housemates debating over who plays an active role in maintaining a relationship, men or women? What happens when the task ends up in an argument between two people of the same gender?

videos.title: Day 13: Fake, Faker, Fakest!
videos.overview: On the brink of eliminations, the tensed housemates are in for a nail-biting session as Kamal Haasan exposes their two-faced nature, one by one.

videos.title: Day 14: Groove Before You Move!
videos.overview: A groovy night comes to a screeching halt as Mamathi, Ananth and Mumtaz face their judgment day. Amidst the symphonious celebration with Kamal Haasan and Shruti Haasan, who's living their final moments in the house?

videos.title: Day 15: Misled Path to Captaincy!
videos.overview: On their run for captaincy, one amongst Vaishnavi and Senrayan reveals the secret task assigned to them. Will it result in a disqualification?

videos.title: Day 16: Injustice In The House?
videos.overview: The new luxury budget task is testing Vaishnavi's captaincy as she faces criticism for her unfair evaluation. Is she doing justice to her role?

videos.title: Day 17: You Can't Fool Me!
videos.overview: In the heat of the luxury budget task the housemates engage in fierce arguments while Bhalajie opts deception as the best tactic to win. However, Mumtaz is unlikely to be fooled.

videos.title: Day 18: Mumtaz Proves Herself!
videos.overview: Birthday girl Mumtaz shows that she is in it to win. Watch as she finishes the last leg of the luxury budget task with ease where the other contestants are struggling.

videos.title: Day 19: A Conjecture of Separation
videos.overview: While some of the housemates gang up on each other over trivial issues, Bigg Boss sets the stage for the contestants to pour out their feelings for their loved ones.

videos.title: Day 20: Kamal Haasan in Tears
videos.overview: The Universal Actor, Kamal Haasan sheds tears on stage, listening to Daniel's heartbreaking story. Amidst the overwhelming emotions, one among the nominated escapes eliminations.

videos.title: Day 21: The Evicted Holds Authority!
videos.overview: As the door to reality slides open, Ponnambalam and Ananth take their final steps towards eviction. Who amongst the housemates will make an exit and win a chance to sentence a jail term?

videos.title: Day 22: United for Ponnambalam
videos.overview: Anand's decision to send Ponnambalam to jail has the housemates begging Bigg Boss to rethink the decision. Mahat, Yashika and Aishwarya's friendship is on the line as they are forced to make a tough decision.

videos.title: Day 23: Ponnambalam's Unexpected Move
videos.overview: As the eager contestants buckle up for the upcoming task, the house decends into total chaos after Ponnambalam does something unexpected.

videos.title: Day 24: Taking It Too Far!
videos.overview: A major breach of the rules in the task brings out the nasty side of the contestants. From cutthroat arguments to a few housemates quitting the game midway, it's a big confusion in the house.

videos.title: Day 25: Everything Has a Price
videos.overview: The luxury budget task has the commoners coming up with ingenious ways to make the others cough up money. Catch what happens when Bigg Boss gives the housemates a chance to resolve all their conflicts.

videos.title: Day 26: Kadaikutty Singam in the House
videos.overview: Karthi, Soori and Director Pandiraj's surprise visit to the house has the contestants in a festive mood. Catch the cast of Kadaikutty Singam as they join the housemates in a fun-filled game of dumb charades.

videos.title: Day 27: Through Hunger and Poverty
videos.overview: Kamal Hassan questions Ramya regarding her poor judgment as a captain. Catch Senrayan and Kamal Hassan share their heart-wrenching experience with hunger and poverty.

videos.title: Day 28: Kamal Haasan Gets Frisky
videos.overview: As the clock ticks closer to eviction, Kamal Haasan gets playful before making the big announcement. Will it be Aishwarya's best friend, Yashika or Bhalajie's love, Nithya?

videos.title: Day 29: Sneak Peek to Finale?
videos.overview: The captaincy task has Mahat, Bhalajie and Shariq choosing their helper who will take the plunge for them. Catch the housemates reveal their thoughts of who might be the finalist.

videos.title: Day 30: Recite Your Flaws with Snehan
videos.overview: Wearing a school uniform and coming to terms with their flaws through poems with hidden meanings is the only way to win a luxury budget. Who will win the special appreciation from Snehan?

videos.title: Day 31: Letter to a Loved One
videos.overview: Aishwarya writes a heartfelt letter to her special friend. Tune in to find out why the housemates reveal their emotions and frustrations to Vaishnavi.

videos.title: Day 32: Senrayan Faces the Heat
videos.overview: Senrayan stands in the line of fire when his repeated questioning leads to a major brawl. Will it be a moment of self-realisation as special guests from various children's homes share their life stories with the contestants?

videos.title: Day 33: Daniel Gains Authority
videos.overview: The contestants are tasked to introduce their favourite personality from among the housemates. Later, the nominated contestants are given an opportunity to justify themselves. By the powers vested by Bigg Boss, Daniel sends a housemate to jail.

videos.title: Day 34: Ponnambalam’s Many Problems
videos.overview: Kamal Haasan gives a social message after Ponnambalam speaks about his childhood. Ponnambalam and Vaishnavi complain about a housemate to Kamal Haasan. All is not well between Ponnambalam and Aishwarya. Why?

videos.title: Day 35: Will Ramya's Wish Come True?
videos.overview: With the threat of elimination looming over her head, Ramya confesses to Kamal Hassan that she would be much happier away from all the conflicts and drama of the house. Tune in to find out if her wish comes true.

videos.title: Day 36: Time for Some Punishment
videos.overview: Bigg Boss decides to make an example out of Mahat for all the rules that have been broken in the house. Catch what happens when Vaishnavi tries to clear Aishwarya's misconceptions.

videos.title: Day 37: Shariq Gets Grilled
videos.overview: While the housemates fight during the luxury budget task which is dedicated in honour of the Kargil Heroes, Shariq gets grilled when he tries to bring peace in the house.

videos.title: Day 38: Mumtaz and Shariq Lock Horns!
videos.overview: Mumtaz's attempt to set foot into the other teams territory turns into an ugly dispute between her and Shariq. With fingers being pointed at one another and ego's hurt, is this an end to the mother-son relationship between the two?

videos.title: Day 39: Mumtaz, a Villain?
videos.overview: Mumtaz's adamant demeanour topped by her rudeness is testing the contestants' patience, one task at a time. Will Shariq manage to mellow it down as the captain, or will they stand up against her?

videos.title: Day 40: Dogfight for Dominance
videos.overview: Mahat openly disobeys his team leader's orders. The unique luxury budget task has the housemates engage in a brutal battle for dominance.

videos.title: Day 41: Setting the Stage for Vishwaroopam 2

videos.overview: Panapetti 2.0 task intensifies as housemates race to increase the prize money. Ramya and Apsara enter the house, and evictees battle it out to raise the pot.

videos.title: BBTam Day 95: Can The Final 6 Pull It Off?
videos.overview: The finalists must execute a secret mission to hide Kemy inside the house. Can they complete the multiple levels of the task unnoticed? Meanwhile, the LBW team enters the BB House.

videos.title: BBTam Day 96: Vinoth's Shocking Move
videos.overview: Drama brews with clashes between the Top Six and evictees before the Pulambinaa Panam task. Later, as Aurora reaches the money box, Vinoth drops a shocker that stuns the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 97: First Encounters, Final Farewells
videos.overview: VJS discusses the shift in dynamics between ex-housemates and finalists. A heartfelt farewell for Vinoth follows, as housemates recall their first interactions.

videos.title: BBTam Day 98: Chinna Kurumpadam, Bigg Twists
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan gives ex-housemates a shot to campaign for the finalists, while Kurumpadam uncovers drama. In a jaw-dropping twist, just 4 finalists survive and Sandra waves goodbye.

videos.title: BBTam Day 99: Finale Week
videos.overview: The Top Four light up as Amit, Kalaiyarasan, Prajin and Tushaar arrive. Misunderstandings between Aurora and Tushaar vanish, and the house gears up for the finale with fun tasks.

videos.title: BBTam Day 100: Celebrating the Bigg Milestone
videos.overview: The winning speeches of the finalists take center stage, while Aurora hands a letter to Tushaar. A prank by Kani and Subhiksha upsets Vikram, before housemates celebrate 100 days.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 101: Friendship, Fights and Feelings
videos.overview: Diwakar fights Divya. Sandra and Vinoth return, resolving issues and consoling Aurora. The house celebrates Bhogi and bonds over friendship memories.

videos.title: BBTam Day 102: Pongalo Pongal!
videos.overview: The Bigg Boss house is buzzing! New tasks, wild missions, and explosive fights bring real drama and endless entertainment.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 103: A Blast from the Past
videos.overview: A fight compilation sparks a clash between Prajean and Diwakar. Sandy and Kavin visit for a movie promo and dance! Vikram gets emotional watching his journey video.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 104: The Final Night in the House
videos.overview: Divya, Sabari & Aurora relive their journeys. The Top four get a makeover for the finale. BB's touching words leave everyone in tears as ex-contestants bid a heavy-hearted goodbye.

videos.title: BB Tam Day 105: Grand Finale
videos.overview: The wait is over! The 105-day journey ends tonight as Vijay Sethupathi lights up the stage to crown the winner of this season.

videos.title: Bigg Boss Tamil S10
videos.overview: Makkal Selvan Vijay Sethupathi returns with a new season that’s bold, unpredictable, and packed with drama. Let the chaos begin!

videos.title: BBTam Day 1: Who Deserves to be A Leader?
videos.overview: Bigg Boss welcomes everyone with the ‘Night Stars’ task.The democracy rules are read and each one gets to pitch their leadership qualities. Who will emerge as the first leader?

videos.title: BBTam Day 2: The Power Cards are Here!
videos.overview: As kitchen team does the luxury budget shopping, Avinash manages to win the Asura Pasi task. Amidst the arguments and chaos, BB announces some special power cards.

videos.title: BBTam Day 3: A Shocking Exit
videos.overview: Mukesh chooses Muniyamma and Chandini for the Style Patrol, while arguments erupt in the leader's meet. Avinash gets unlimited food, and a surprise exit leaves everyone emotional.

videos.title: BBTam Day 4: New Entry and Leadership Crisis
videos.overview: Kitchen fights end in a captaincy shift, Muniyamma breaks down in jail, and a new commoner enters. Tensions peak in the democracy question hour as leader Shatiga gets targeted.

videos.title: BBTam Day 5: The First Eviction Stuns All
videos.overview: Vinoth becomes leader and names three weakest performers. Eviction voting sends one out, while the Review Board puts Lakshmipriya in danger.

videos.title: BBTam Day 6: Vijay Sethupati Takes the Stage
videos.overview: VJS welcomes Manivannan and later discusses democracy with the housemates. He grills Shathiga on leadership and Vinoth Babu on opposition duties.

videos.title: BBTam Day 7: Eviction and New Rules
videos.overview: VJS questions the evictee and asks to describe the housemates. He checks on the contestants about the new power system, and then asks them to name two least deserving leaders.

videos.title: BBTam Day 8: Wild Card Entry
videos.overview: The new entry sparks tension. As Shama dominates the leadership task, democracy room drama triggers a walkout. Luxury shopping and nominations add more chaos.

videos.title: BBTam Day 9: Welcome to the Battleground
videos.overview: The kitchen becomes ground zero for fights when housemates clash over their duties and tea. The tasks add fuel to the fire as punishments are given and stories are stopped midway.

videos.title: BBTam Day 10: Eviction Free Pass Is Here!
videos.overview: Ansar’s ratings raise eyebrows, while kitchen drama brings Anandhi to tears. As physical tussles erupt in the cheese task for the pass, Shama changes the least deserving list.

videos.title: BBTam Day 11: Power Shifts and Food War
videos.overview: What begins with a food clash, ends in an assembly revolt. A dramatic resignation and high-stakes re-election follows. Who will become the new leader?

videos.title: BBTam Day 12: New King and Servants
videos.overview: Task disputes bring debates over fair play among the contestants. Prithvi becomes king with three servants, an eviction looms, and two members head straight to jail.

videos.title: BBTam Day 13: VJS Exposes Housemates' Bias
videos.overview: Vijay Sethupati welcomes Anandhi and grills Shama over her leadership, task U-turns. He then calls out the ruling team in the Democracy Room for failing to support their own.

videos.title: BBTam Day 14: Who Will Join VJS Onstage
videos.overview: Anandi upsets VJS while he discusses the task issues. Leaderships are compared, and Mukesh saves one with the Eviction Free Pass. Who will finally bid goodbye today?

videos.title: BBTam Day 15: New Leader and Nominations!
videos.overview: Avinash is the new leader! As he sorts the teams, ruling vs opposition clash over the cleaning rules. Ansar and Shathiga's food spat precedes a tense nomination round.

videos.title: BBTam Day 16: Titles and Transformations
videos.overview: Muniyammal’s comments raise eyebrows. Later, housemates impersonate each other in a fun content creator task before assigning sarcastic titles in a board game.

videos.title: BBTam Day 17: Avinash's Strategic Move
videos.overview: Clashes, tears and tough calls! Shama-Jason fight halts the task, but Avinash wins big. Asmitha struggles with Anandhi, while the exit board results leave Shathiga in tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 18: Exit Board Triggers Tiffs
videos.overview: Muniyammal confronts Avinash over her exit board spot. Later in democracy proceedings Jason's question triggers chaos. Avinash reshuffles the board, getting into trouble again.

videos.title: BBTam Day 19: Angry Tears and Angry Exits
videos.overview: Lakshmi Priya gets evicted. However, before leaving, she has a lot to say to Avinash. Meanwhile, Bigg Boss calls the housemates to the confession room for a special selection.

videos.title: BBTam Day 20: Eviction Twist Unvieled
videos.overview: Anandhi's eviction twist is revealed, and the shame segment targets Raghav. Avinash is praised as well as critisised by VJS, while Jason and Shama get a earful for their behaviour.

videos.title: BBTam Day 21: VJS Drops A Major Game Twist
videos.overview: VJS confronts about the passive gameplay and questions Avinash's board choices. Javeed, Lakshmi Priya and Saviniya return as VJS reveals a twist, sweeping everyone off their feet.

videos.title: BBTam Day 22: Hotel Task with New Rules
videos.overview: Open nominations shake up the house, but BB twists the game. The Hotel task is launched with three pairs of guests. As manager Shama takes charge, how will this battle proceed?

videos.title: BBTam Day 23: Task Wars and Ruthless Roast
videos.overview: Housemates fight over washrooms and fake tags. The rope creates clashes and hotel guests face harsh consequences for it. The debate and roast battle intensifies the situations.

videos.title: BBTam Day 24: The Big Cash Box Dilemma
videos.overview: Asmitha and Saviniya clash over sleep, leaving Saviniya in tears. BB drops a cash box offer, leaving Kumaran contemplating his choice before the house turns into a wild jungle.

videos.title: BBTam Day 25: Grand Opening, Grand Problem
videos.overview: BB Hotel opens with outrage as food delays anger guests. Manager Lakshmi Priya confronts Dhanya and Javeed over kitchen blunders, leaving Dhanya in tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 26: BB Hotel Gets Reviewed
videos.overview: Fights, tears and tough reviews mark BB Hotel 2.0. Kumaran cuts the rope to save Lakshmipriya, while Saviniya–Asmitha and Danya–Javeed fail to agree on who stays.

videos.title: BBTam Day 27: VJS Reviews BB Hotel 2.0
videos.overview: VJS quizzes the housemates on the rope choices and the re-entered trio's promises. Shama's managerial stint draws mixed views, while Vijay probes on why BB Hotel 2.0 failed.

videos.title: BBTam Day 28: Wildcards Bring Instant Drama
videos.overview: VJS interacts with Kumaran before the danger-zone housemates award an eviction-free pass. Three wildcards enter with high stake tasks that stir immediate drama in the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 29: New Leader and Nominations
videos.overview: Karishma's questions stirs the house, before a leadership task for the wildcards. Following the nominations process, a bedroom inspection triggers a fight between Vasan and Jason.

videos.title: BBTam Day 30: Chaos, Betrayals and Magic Potions
videos.overview: Avinash and Muniyammal clash disrupts the house. Amidst secret deals and betrayals, the high stakes magic potion task triggers fierce fights between Raghav and Jason.

videos.title: BBTam Day 31: Blue Bricks Rule!
videos.overview: Raghav and Muthazhagi end in tears, while a block-grabbing fairness debate divides the house. As few get eliminated from the task, Jason's comment on Avinash triggers a fight.

videos.title: BBTam Day 32: Complaints and Clarifications
videos.overview: Foul play allegations erupt after Muthazhagi's block move. Democracy room brings apologies and tears, while teams clash for survival in the magic potion task.

videos.title: BBTam Day 33: Victory and Heartfelt Letters
videos.overview: The magic potion task crowns its winners with immunity, while evicted ones face punishments. Worst players are voted for, as anonymous letters bring tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 34: Praises and Warning
videos.overview: VJS appreciates previous week's performances and asks the housemates to review wildcard gameplay. He advises Jason on his remarks.

videos.title: BBTam Day 35: VJS Deals Out A Big Surprise
videos.overview: VJS asks Karishma about secret deal claims and incomplete tasks. Later, letter task emotions take over, and VJS announces a big surprise for the housemates.

videos.title: BBTam Day 36: Masks Off in Open Nominations
videos.overview: A new leadership takes power as the first assembly boils over house rules. Chandini and Jason are punished for rule breaks, while open nominations spark face-to-face fury.

videos.title: BBTam Day 37: The Great Diamond Heist Begins
videos.overview: Shama's washroom mischief triggers chaos and an inquiry. Meanwhile, Muthazhagi clashes with Vasan as the diamond heist task kicks off with a dance twist.

videos.title: BBTam Day 38: Diamond Thieves Strike Tonight
videos.overview: Jason and Lakshmi Priya clash while housemates plot a heist during the dance marathon. When BB relocates the diamond, a daring theft turns the house upside down.

videos.title: BBTam Day 39: The Investigation Begins!
videos.overview: Munniyammal is jailed for the theft while Vasan secretly secures the hidden diamond. Investigators fail after three rounds. Both teams then face off in the Democracy Assembly.

videos.title: BBTam Day 40: Bigg Boss Award Night
videos.overview: Tempers flare as Avinash flings Jason’s clothes and Ansar steps in with punishments. Ansar probes the damage, not knowing Karishma did it. Later, BB Awards light up the night.

videos.title: BBTam Day 41: Vimal Joins Vijay Onstage
videos.overview: VJS discusses open nominations and plays a kurumpadam exposing diamond task gameplay. Later, Vasan retrieves the diamond and wins a power with special guest Vimal.

videos.title: BBTam Day 42: Two Big Exits Stun the House
videos.overview: VJS tackles secret midnight cooking, reviews Ansar's captaincy, and confronts heated clashes. The weekend turns emotional with a sudden medical exit and an eviction.

videos.title: BBTam Day 43: An Array of Arguments
videos.overview: Survival battle begins as Vinoth and Avinash lead the Blue and Red teams. Food, a missing locket and foul-play charges spark clashes before the nomination begins.

videos.title: BBTam Day 44: Survival Task and Luxury Budget
videos.overview: Blue team wins the luxury task after a third round and penalty play, earning luxury shopping. Muniyammal’s food wastage and an unwashed bowl spark clashes between the teams.

videos.title: BBTam Day 45: A Broken Pan and A New Leader
videos.overview: Jason rejects Avinash's team. A heated kitchen clash pushes Avinash to break a pan and quit as captain, while a new leader takes over for the Battle Bridge showdown.

videos.title: BBTam Day 46: Food Stolen, Luggage Locked!
videos.overview: Vasan's food loot raises eyebrows, and later he quarrels with Jason. Amid kitchen twists and breakdowns, one team seizes power by locking their rivals' luggage.

videos.title: BBTam Day 47: Thefts and Secrets Revealed!
videos.overview: Murukku temptation, jam fights and a shocking spy reveal, rattles both teams. Vinoth breaks down, while Vasan’s thefts get laughs, and the red team gets locked out.

videos.title: BBTam Day 48: Ramya Krishnan Takes Charge
videos.overview: Host Ramya Krishnan reviews weekly uniqueness, deals, and food raids. She corners Jason over his team switch and fight with Muniyammal, while grilling Avinash's captaincy exit.

videos.title: BBTam Day 49: Eviction Shock at the Halfway Mark
videos.overview: As housemates celebrate a milestone, Ramya questions their choices. Later, eviction free pass holders decline safety, leading to an eviction that stuns the house.

videos.title: BBTam Day 50: Garlands and Bigg Drama
videos.overview: Open nomination happens with garlands, while Muniyammal's bitter gourd demand during the luxury budget shopping brings laughter. Hard questions emerge in BB Unfiltered.

videos.title: BBTam Day 51: Cowboys Raid and Loot Food
videos.overview: The Cowboys vs Mining Mafia task begins. After intense rounds, the Cowboys raid the kitchen supplies. The Mining Mafia get furious as secret clues expose their food theft.

videos.title: BBTam Day 52: Brutal Raids and Breakdowns
videos.overview: Akshitha creates drama by dumping housemates' clothes into the pool. The Cowboys get a chance to bring Vasan back. Brutal raids leave the house upside down, pushing Vinod to tears.

videos.title: BBTam Day 53: Internal Rifts and Bigg Twists
videos.overview: A ration trade leaves Muniyammal upset. On one side a bitter loss sparks team drama, and on the other, BB shocks the house with a surprise area swap as teams battle for perks.

videos.title: BBTam Day 54: An Emotional Sentence to Jail
videos.overview: Food fights kick off the day, and the weekly task ends with Danya and Karishma sent to jail. Prithvi faces heat for giving water to the inmates.

videos.title: BBTam Day 55: Is Akshitha Guilty?
videos.overview: VJS reviews the luxury task, exposing Mining Mafia's flawed choices and slamming Cowboys' dirty conduct. Tension peaks as video proof confirms the accusations on Akshitha.

videos.title: BBTam Day 56: Eviction Pass Changes Dynamics
videos.overview: VJS questions the housemates over thrown food and clothes. He pulls up Akshitha and Danya, while Vasan turns Mukesh's saviour. Rest of the two in danger, face eviction.

videos.title: BBTam Day 57: New Leader, New Nominations
videos.overview: Lakshmipriya takes the leader’s crown, but luxury shopping brings complaints. Jason is confronted after nominations with chocolates, while the ranking task sets off fierce debates.

videos.title: BBTam Day 58: An Academy for Erring Elders
videos.overview: Post the debates and disputes, Jason bags the top rank. In the academy task, housemates play naughty elders reforming their bad habits, and Vinoth’s Tamil class sparks laughter.

videos.title: BBTam Day 59: Codewords and Killers
videos.overview: Ansar’s salt heist sparks laughs, but food scarcity triggers chaos. The game turns sinister as Asmitha and Jason unite via secret codewords to hunt their first target.

videos.title: BBTam Day 60: Killers Exposed as Graveyard Fills
videos.overview: The Truth or Lie task turns bitter as arguments break out and Asmitha eyes her next target. The house is left shell shocked when BB reveals the two killers and their victims.

videos.title: BBTam Day 61: Who Is the Real Killer?
videos.overview: Vasan's investigation gets complicated as yet another murder takes place. Housemates suspect each other, while Vasan and Dhanya are sent to jail for being the worst performers.

videos.title: BBTam Day 62: VJS Unveils the Killer
videos.overview: VJS corners Muniyammal over task blunders and plays a shocking murder kurumpadam. After grilling detective Vasan, housemates vote, putting Muniyammal and Danya on the spot.

videos.title: BBTam Day 63: Diwali Dhamaka with VJS
videos.overview: VJS wishes the housemates with a festive feast. He then questions the ranking task and the best performer selection. Later, the double eviction sweeps everyone off their feet.

videos.title: BBTam Day 64: Who Controls the House Now?
videos.overview: A midnight siren shocks the house as a new Junior BB is elected and a fresh leader takes charge. Later, mixed nominations ignite explosive drama between Mukesh and Muthazhagi.

videos.title: BBTam Day 65: The Fall of Junior BB?
videos.overview: A fake fight assigned by Junior BB to Mukesh and Danya sparks genuine concern before triggering house outrage. Later, furious housemates unite to strip Vinoth of his power.

videos.title: BBTam Day 66: Power Shifts Twice in One Day
videos.overview: A new Junior BB takes charge. An emotional Vinoth demands answers, and flaws are exposed. Later, the courtroom task sparks a bitter Jason-Vinoth groupism fight.

videos.title: BBTam Day 67: The Housemates Miss BB
videos.overview: Jason sparks a feud over favoritism, while housemates write letters to Bigg Boss expressing how much they miss him. The debate to replace Junior BB Ansar ends in a total deadlock.

videos.title: BBTam Day 68: The OG Bigg Boss Returns
videos.overview: Hunger, heated clashes and heartfelt apologies fill the day. Later, BB’s emotional return and praise for the HMs and Junior BBs tops it off.

videos.title: BBTam Day 69: VJS Exposes Selective Outrage
videos.overview: VJS discusses Bigg Boss's absence with the housemates before grilling Jason and Shathiga over shifting explanations, double standards, and the Junior BB replacement controversy.

videos.title: BBTam Day 70: The Top 10 of S10
videos.overview: VJS grills Jason over his failed captaincy and physical clash, issuing a final warning. Amidst emotional moments and a double eviction, Season 10 celebrates its official top 10.

videos.title: BBTam Day 71: Ticket to Finale Battle Begins
videos.overview: A fierce captaincy race crowns a new face, dividing the house. Paper shredder nominations heat up as Bigg Boss announces the high-stakes ticket to finale build-up week.

videos.title: BBTam Day 72: Mukesh Ruins the Task
videos.overview: Operation Rescue begins with the housemates listing whom to save from the bus blast. Mukesh’s gameplay wipes out all points, and BB orders a restart amidst fresh fights.

videos.title: BBTam Day 73: Task Turns Brutal
videos.overview: Muniyammal vs Vasan fight escalates. In the build-up week challenge, housemates have to trigger and remove the one seated on the King's chair, which ends in chaos.

videos.title: BBTam Day 74: Contract Killadis in the House
videos.overview: Tempers flare over scoring and comparisons. A murder-themed task ignites chaos, while Danya clashes with Jason over sugar after a round of eliminations.

videos.title: BBTam Day 75: Vasan's Calculated Betrayal
videos.overview: Vasan's tricky move draws criticism. As the task comes to an end, the winner gets an advantage for the Ticket to Finale week, while the worst performers get locked in the jail.

videos.title: BBTam Day 76: A Reality Check from VJS
videos.overview: VJS hears out Ansar, Lakshmi Priya and Vasan on their separate issues with Muniyammal. He then puts Mukesh and Vasan on the spot over zero scores and a broken deal.

videos.title: BBTam Day 77: The Eviction Shockwave
videos.overview: Captaincy controversies, sharp questions and unexpected saves keep the house on edge. VJS puts the housemates on spot before the shocking eviction verdict.

videos.title: BBTam Day 78: Letters at a Cost
videos.overview: Ansar and Vasan go head-to-head in the captaincy task. Meanwhile, Anbin Kural takes an emotional turn as housemates compete for a chance to receive the letters from their families.

videos.title: BBTam Day 79: Love and Laughter
videos.overview: Family visits bring laughter and heartfelt moments as Vinoth Babu and Lakshmi Priya receive advice. An emotional roller coaster begins when BB puts the loved ones to test.

videos.title: BBTam Day 80: BB has a Little Fan
videos.overview: Tension over a tea mix-up and duty shifting gives way to heartwarming moments. Prithvi and Ansar's families arrive, with Ansar's kids charming Bigg Boss.

videos.title: BBTam Day 81: It's Dhanya and Vasan's Turn
videos.overview: Muniyamma is called out for dodging duties and promises to clean the kitchen alone. Danya's and Vasan's families bring warmth, advice and emotional moments.
